parts.text: Have you ever heard of imaginary friends?
Maybe you even had one yourself when you were a child.
They’re such fascinating beings, born from sentimental objects that receive enough love and memories.
Have you ever had a sentimental object?
A favorite toy your parents bought you, a blanket you always snuggled with, a plushie that helped you through hard times?
Sentimental objects, imagination, and an identity. These are the basis of all imaginary friends. Without them, their lives cease to exist.
Where are your sentimental objects now?
Were they donated or given away? Are they collecting dust in your closet?
Are they rotting in a landfill?
If you had an imaginary friend, how do you think they’re doing?
Where do they go once you’ve grown up and no longer need them?
…when an imaginary friend is truly forgotten?
